method_definitions.B0: filename-stem Jaccard lexical proxy; ties follow NPZ member order
method_definitions.B1: top-10 B0 seeds interleaved with sorted undirected calls neighbors
method_definitions.B2: top-1 B0 seed followed by sorted undirected calls neighbors
method_definitions.R3_oracle_1hop: legacy key: gold-first oracle ranking, NOT a one-hop traversal
method_definitions.delivery: not measured; no serialization or truncation is simulated

gold_definition: gold patch 改动文件对应的图节点集合（文件级 coarse gold）
caveats: 官方 embedding 是仓库内符号的 code embedding，没有任意文本编码器；B0/B1/B2 的检索信号用「problem_statement 词干 vs 节点文件名词干的 Jaccard」作为独立词干代理；不是 embedding 检索下界，也不是 search_similar_code 的复现。
gold 是文件级而非符号级；符号级需要解压快照取源码，成本不在本脚本内。
token 数为 字符数/4 的显式近似，未使用真实分词器。

normalization.note: Lexical-score times stored-vector norm sensitivity; not embedding-query normalization
